implementation_strategy: Hosted-model execution (openai_responses gpt-5-mini, temperature=0) with deterministic prompts; shared-initial-candidate semantics per task (one initial generation serving both conditions) and at most one guarded repair call per task. Deterministic canonicalizers, parse-tree canonicalization, CPU-bound verifier and lightweight topology simulator executed locally in Docker/CPU. All scoring and exclusion decisions automated. Totals derived: expected calls = 300 tasks * 1.5 expected calls/task = 450 estimated_model_calls; maximum calls = 300 * 2 = 600.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection from the provided synthetic-topology/template pool: indices 1–150 = simple single-statement intents; 151–300 = complex multi-statement intents. Exact-string and token-similarity checks applied pre-run to move contaminated items to exploratory.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use stored deterministic artifacts: CLI canonicalizer, vendor-agnostic token map JSONs, AST parse-tree canonicalizer, and frozen repair-prompt templates. Automatic rejection if round-trip parse-tree equality or reachability-preserving checks fail.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation: deterministic stratified assignment (1–150 simple, 151–300 complex) as preregistered.
caching_plan: Cache all initial model responses, verifier outputs, canonicalized configs, simulator traces, and artifact hashes to local CPU storage; reuse cached artifacts for deterministic auditing and analysis. Cached items indexed by task index hash.
failure_recovery_plan: Per-adapter constraint: maximum_attempts_per_call=1. Any provider/API call returning a non-recoverable error is logged as technical failure and the pair is handled per missingness_plan (complete-pair primary: exclude pairs missing a valid binary outcome). No automated re-attempts of the same call are performed.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 v1.0: per-task paired binary outcomes (deterministic-verifier pass/fail for baseline and guarded), flags for exclusions/contamination, model-call counts, wall-clock latency, canonicalized configs, verifier and simulator traces, and artifact hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: All LLM calls via hosted API (openai_responses gpt-5-mini). Verifier and simulator run on CPU inside Docker containers. Estimated API calls: 450 (see derivation in implementation_strategy). Maximum API calls reserved: 600. Wall-clock: with modest parallelism (6 batches) and per-call latency ~0.5–2s, expect experiment completion within 2 days; worst-case provider latency allowance included within 7-day wall-clock limit.
